text: Evasive means good at slipping away and avoiding being caught. Here, the butterfly twists and dodges so well that birds struggle to catch it.
Feeble means weak. Feebler means weaker. Here, the grasshopper's color match to the butterfly is weaker than its movement match.
A pursuit is a chase. Here, a bird would have to chase the butterfly so long that the small meal is not worth the effort.
Mimicry is when one living thing looks or acts like another to gain an advantage. A harmless animal that looks like a dangerous one is a mimic.
Batesian mimicry is named after Henry Bates. It means a harmless animal copies the look of a harmful or yucky one so predators leave it alone.
Predators are animals that hunt and eat other animals. Birds are predators of grasshoppers.
Prey is an animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal. Here, the bird may think its prey got away.
Fatal means causing death. Looking tasty is a fatal mistake for a small animal because it will get eaten.
A naturalist is a person who studies plants and animals in nature. Henry Bates was one.
An entomologist is a scientist who studies insects, like grasshoppers and butterflies.
Unpalatable means tasting so bad that an animal will not want to eat it. The mourning cloak is not unpalatable.
A venomous animal injects poison with a bite or sting, like some snakes and wasps.
Toxic means poisonous. Birds avoid toxic caterpillars because eating one would make them sick.
To nab something is to catch or grab it quickly. Collectors nab grasshoppers by mistake.
To pin something down is to figure out exactly what it is. The scientists found the benefit hard to pin down.
Lazy flaps are slow, relaxed wing beats, as if the insect were not trying hard.
High-speed videos record a huge number of pictures every second, so fast motion like wing flaps can be watched in slow motion.
Modest means small or not very big. The color similarities were modest, meaning only a little alike.
A hue is a color or a shade of a color. Here, the grasshopper's yellow is a different shade from the butterfly's.
Distinctive means easy to recognize because it stands out. The butterfly's blue spots are distinctive.
A wing and a prayer is a play on the phrase 'a wing and a prayer,' which means trying something with little hope. Here it is a joke about wings.
Wingbeat frequency is how many times a wing flaps each second.
Hertz is a unit that counts how many times something repeats each second. Twenty hertz means twenty flaps every second.
Gliding means moving smoothly through the air without flapping. The grasshoppers glide with wings out.
Peers are others of the same kind or group. Here, the grasshopper's peers are the other grasshopper species.
Deceptive means tricking someone into believing something false. The grasshopper's movement tricks birds.
To compensate for something is to make up for a weakness. Good movement makes up for the weaker color match.
Evolution is the slow change in living things over many generations, as helpful traits become more common.
A staple is something that is eaten or used all the time. Grasshoppers are a regular food for many birds.
A resemblance is a likeness. The grasshopper looks like a yellow butterfly in flight.
Abruptly means suddenly, without warning. The grasshopper folds its wings abruptly when it lands.
A hypothesis is a scientist's best guess about why something happens, which still needs testing.
Lacklustre means dull and not exciting. Here it describes a plain costume.
An impresario is a person who organizes shows, like plays or concerts.
Choreography is the planned set of moves in a dance or performance. The joke is that the grasshopper's moves make up for a plain costume.
The mourning cloak is a butterfly with dark wings edged in yellow. It is common in North America.
The Carolina grasshopper is a large grasshopper with black-and-yellow hind wings that looks like the mourning cloak in flight.
Henry Bates was a British naturalist who described this kind of mimicry in 1862 after studying butterflies.
Tom Sherratt is the scientist at Carleton University who led the study of the grasshoppers.
Carleton University is a university in Ottawa, the capital of Canada.
